usedFor: Wildapricot holds members, payments and events, and MailerLite keeps them as subscribers through “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Membership Created” in Wildapricot, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A new member joins your list, and a returning one is updated instead of duplicated.

watchOut: “Membership Is Suspended” in Wildapricot can also feed MailerLite, so decide how a suspended member should be listed.
